population: Six public KartaView UAE driver-view photographs on six previously unused recording sequences and capture days. Three eligible ground regions and three negative cases were chosen by an independent AI visual reviewer before model or detector outputs. No human labels, real driving intervention or legal clearance assessment.
criteria: The same numeric scorer as the third field is reused. A direct correct answer must put its explicit, persisted native point strictly inside a separately frozen polygon. A vehicle-only outline (IoU >= 0.50), a list of selectable alternate locations, a wrong-region pin, a completed clarification and a browser/model failure are separate. Each independent through-lane tap is scored in a clean session. Browser wall time excludes source preparation and human saving time.
reproduce: Extract the three Python files under methods together and run python grade_fourth.py --replay <archive.zip>. No model or source image is required to reproduce the scores. For the separate assisted readback, place methods/supplement_fourth.py beside grade_browser.py, then run python supplement_fourth.py <archive.zip>.

after_unsealing_assisted.design: After the six first requests and six lane clicks were sealed and scored, repeat the original requests in ordinary Microsoft Edge and press the real mark button. Tap the preregistered ground inside each eligible site or the specifically obstructed spot for each control. Any conditional choice requires an explicit selection and then a separate Save. This is an assisted test after disclosure and cannot earn first-turn accuracy.
after_unsealing_assisted.native_read: The released source-bound segmentation raster was reloaded independently. Counts cover the browser's actual tap rectangle and its 49-cell neighbourhood. The application's vehicle relation, collision and parking checks are additional conditions. A semantic class at one point cannot prove the whole bay or permission to stop.

rows.passenger_words: Can you let me out behind the black pickup on the left?
rows.original_reply: I found the outlined black pickup. I can’t verify open curbside ground behind it. Could you mark the area you mean?
rows.independently_visible_rear: The black pickup's tailgate faces the camera and right. It and the neighbouring cars are parked at an angle in front of the shops.
rows.independently_visible_ground: A wide shop-front apron is continuously visible beneath the row, ending at a diagonal asphalt seam. The shortlisted native region lies beyond the tailgate, entirely on the apron, before the running lane and clear of the silver sedan next to the pickup. No complete painted bay is claimed.
rows.assisted_reply: I can see open parking pavement at your exact mark. I couldn’t verify its position relative to the vehicle you described. Do you want to use the spot you marked? You can also mark another spot.

rows.independently_visible_ground: The vehicle is parked against the raised right kerb. White round studs trace its rear stall boundary and a visible seam continues toward the bonnet. Inside the conservative polygon there is empty, road-level ground within this row, separate from the central travel lane and the raised sidewalk. Only the visible portion is labelled.

sampling: The original 81-photo bank had already undergone a behind-vehicle coverage audit, so six brand-new public KartaView drives were chosen instead. All are distinct from 913 prior or screened drives and more than 180 m from 4,528 camera positions in the exclusion registry. The six capture dates are distinct and absent from the three preceding fields. Official KartaView UAE country metadata and CC BY-SA 4.0 terms were verified. Previously updated code was known; its outputs on these photos were not.
driver_acceptance_interpretation: All three eligible vehicles were individually and correctly outlined, so identity was successfully communicated in those requests. The initial system supplied zero eligible ground locations. An open apron, a parking row defined by white studs and a warehouse gravel frontage have distinct physical cues; combining a vehicle outline and a broad semantic class does not verify a load-bearing, vehicle-accessible area behind the vehicle. An application failure does not count as a correct refusal.

assisted_journal.approach: A directly checked, unoccupied exact mark followed by a choice and Save; this did not confirm its physical relation to the pickup or the full extent of a bay.
